prompt: On a coordinate plane, find the distance from $(3, 2)$ to $(3, 7)$.
hint: The two points share a coordinate. See which one it is, because that tells you whether the segment is vertical or horizontal.

hints.text: The two points share a coordinate. See which one it is, because that tells you whether the segment is vertical or horizontal.
Both points have $x = 3$, so the segment is vertical. The distance is the difference of the $y$-values, $|7 - 2|$.

explanation: Both points have $x = 3$, so they lie on the same vertical line.
For points on a vertical line, the distance is the absolute value of the difference of the $y$-values.
Compute it: $|7 - 2| = 5$. The distance is $5$ units.
